description: This Java class models a request for autocomplete functionality, generating a JSON-formatted query string based on merchant and language codes, and an input query. It provides methods to produce the JSON string and construct a collection name based on its properties.

classes.name: AutoCompleteRequest
classes.description: A class representing an autocomplete request, capable of producing a JSON string for search queries and constructing collection names based on merchant and language codes.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for the autocomplete query based on the input query parameter.

methods.name: getCollectionName
methods.description: Constructs a collection name string based on the keyword, language, and merchant codes.
